hero.title: A Portuguese virtual number for SMS verification
intro: Portugal gives you something slightly rare: a Western European number that doesn't carry Western European weight in price. A +351 mobile reads as unmistakably EU to any service that checks — WhatsApp, Instagram, Uber — while staying one of the more accessible codes on the continent.
SMS Code rents you a real Portuguese mobile number in one tap. Enter it at the verification step, and the SMS with your code shows up in the app usually within seconds — receive it, copy it, done.

whyCountry.title: Why choose a Portuguese number?
body: Reach for Portugal when the account should look Western European. Services that treat numbers differently by region put +351 firmly in the EU bucket — useful for marketplaces, ride apps and social accounts meant to live in a European context. WhatsApp and Telegram treat Portuguese mobiles as everyday traffic, and Uber and AliExpress accounts anchored to one look entirely at home.

Portuguese numbers are pleasantly simple: nine digits after the +351, with mobiles always starting on 9 — 91, 92, 93 or 96. There's no trunk zero to strip and no mobile-versus-landline puzzle at the form; the nine-digit block starting with 9 is the entire number.

tips.title: Nine digits, starts with 9, no zero
tips.body: Portugal never uses a domestic leading zero, so what you see is what you type: +351 and the nine digits beginning with 9. If a number offered to you starts with 2, that's a landline range — for SMS verification you want the 9X mobiles.

tips.title: An EU badge without the premium
tips.body: When a sign-up flow behaves differently for European numbers — currencies, regional catalogs, delivery options — a Portuguese mobile flips it to the EU path just as surely as a German or French one, and typically at a friendlier rate.

tips.title: Use the window while it's open
tips.body: The rental covers a limited window for the SMS to arrive. Request the code the moment the number is yours — and if it never comes, the activation cancels free, so retrying with a fresh +351 number costs nothing but a minute.

faqs.q: Is it a real Portuguese mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes — a real carrier-network number in Portugal's standard nine-digit mobile format. Services see a normal Portuguese phone, not a receive-only virtual address.

faqs.q: What are Portuguese numbers typically used for?
faqs.a: Messengers first — WhatsApp and Telegram — plus Instagram, Uber and AliExpress accounts that should read as Western European. As an EU number it's accepted broadly wherever European mobiles are.

faqs.q: Do I have to be in Portugal to receive the SMS?
faqs.a: No. The number and its messages live in the SMS Code app, so your location and your own SIM card don't enter into it — the code reaches you wherever you are.

faqs.q: What if the verification code never arrives?
faqs.a: Then the activation costs you nothing. Cancel it in the app, take a fresh Portuguese number and request the code again — you only pay for activations that deliver an SMS.

faqs.q: Can I reuse the number for another service later?
faqs.a: Each activation is tied to one service for its window. If you need to verify several services, run separate activations — each one is paid from your coin balance individually.
